observations: The mounted viewer reported three protein rows, 191 alignment columns, mean identity 0.9284467713787081, and normalized conservation 0.6453400570165564.
KRAS positions 10-17, 30-38, 60-76, and 116-119 were identical across all three rows.
Alignment columns 170-191 contained substantially more substitutions and short gaps.
interpretation: The shared GTPase core is highly conserved across the three human RAS paralogues.
The C-terminal targeting region contains more paralogue-specific variation.
limitations: The distance matrix uses uncorrected p-distance.
The three-leaf neighbor-joining tree is exploratory and has no substitution model or support assessment.
The SVG preview is a project-owned summary drawn from exact model-visible viewer results because source-relative viewer publication was unavailable.
